Bajaj Group Launches Integrated Healthcare Venture in Pune

The Bajaj Group is launching a new integrated healthcare venture, beginning with a 500-bed hospital in Pune that is set to open next week. This initiative represents a new model of healthcare delivery for the group, extending beyond traditional hospital services.
